title: TSM BPO Client Onboarding: From Access Code to Visible Case
story: ADMIN CONSOLE > CLIENT PORTAL > CASE VISIBLE
valueProposition: A client engagement goes from created to visible to the client in minutes, not days.
_note: Scripted scenario against the real, live BPO backend (same routes proven in docs/bpo-client-onboarding.md) -- no mocked engine output, no real client name. The client is named 'Sample BPO Client' and every record this capture creates is deleted afterward.

states.caption: Admin opens the BPO client console
states.narration: This is the BPO client console. It is where a new client engagement begins.

states.caption: Starting a new client engagement
states.narration: The admin opens the new client form. No separate system, no spreadsheet.

states.caption: Client created — a secure access code is generated
states.narration: One click creates the client and generates a secure access code, ready to hand to them.

states.caption: The client signs in with that access code
states.narration: The client signs in with the access code they were given. No separate onboarding call, no shared login.

states.caption: Their case is already there, documents included
states.narration: Their case is already there, with its document attached, created and recorded before they ever logged in.
